title: On Convergence of Gradient Temporal-Difference Learning with Regularized Corrections and Eligibility Traces
abstract: arXiv:2611.05869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal-difference (TD) learning underlies many prediction and control algorithms, but can diverge when combined with off-policy learning, bootstrapping, and function approximation. TD with Regularized Corrections (TDRC) is theoretically sound and practically simple, but existing convergence theory covers only the one-step case under i.i.d. sampling, while the Huber Bellman-error formulation has not been extended to TDRC or eligibility traces. In this work, we establish convergence of constrained TDRC($\lambda$) with diminishing stepsizes and non-i.i.d. off-policy data, for state-dependent and history-dependent $\lambda$-parameters. We also propose TDRC($\lambda$)-Huber, which preserves the TDRC($\lambda$) fixed point while reducing sensitivity to large Bellman errors. translated_title: 关于带正则化修正与资格迹的梯度时序差分学习的收敛性研究
translated_abstract: 时序差分（TD）学习是许多预测与控制算法的基础，但当其与离策略学习、自举和函数逼近相结合时可能会发散。带正则化修正的时序差分学习（TDRC）在理论上可靠且在实践中简单，然而现有的收敛性理论仅覆盖了独立同分布采样下的单步情形，且Huber贝尔曼误差形式尚未被扩展到TDRC或资格迹。在本工作中，我们建立了带递减步长和非独立同分布离策略数据下约束型TDRC(λ)的收敛性，适用于状态依赖和历史依赖的λ参数。我们还提出了TDRC(λ)-Huber算法，该算法在保持TDRC(λ)不动点的同时，降低了对大幅贝尔曼误差的敏感性。针对这两种算法，我们应用了随机逼近理论中基于常微分方程（ODE）的弱收敛方法。对于TDRC(λ)-Huber的非线性平均动力学，我们给出……
tldr: 本文首次建立了带资格迹的正则化修正时序差分学习TDRC(λ)在非独立同分布离策略数据下的收敛性理论，并提出TDRC(λ)-Huber算法，在保持TDRC(λ)不动点的同时降低对大幅贝尔曼误差的敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the convergence of TDRC(λ) with eligibility traces under non-i.i.d. off-policy data, and proposes TDRC(λ)-Huber, which preserves the TDRC(λ) fixed point while reducing sensitivity to large Bellman errors.
